text:
mira: idea 1: quick PLG pilot for seed cohort: gated 30m webinar + 25 starter credits + 3-prompt pack. track signup->first-run in 7d.
cal: love it. metric?
mira: 7-day activation (first 3 gen events). target +10% vs control.
josh: can host wed 4/24 16:00.
mira: plan: email + in-app banner (RSVP) -> grant 25 credits on attendance -> send 3-prompt pack after RSVP -> 24h nudge.
samir: segment = signup last 30d, usage=0, exclude paid trials. cal can you export?
cal: will export and drop csv in drive. also will set banner AB (short vs long CTA).
onboard-bot: workflow "credit_assignment_v2" requires approval before cohort write.
josh: tracking params: ?utm_source=seed-pilot&utm_medium=webinar&utm_campaign=seed_pilot_apr24 & route=promptpack
samir: control split 70/30 ok. need ~1.2k users total for power.
mira: QA checklist: segment, approval, RSVP page with utm+route, prompt pack asset, credit grant logic, funnel dashboard.
cal: shared drive: https://drive.redwood.example/seed-pilot. looping infra if needed.
mira: sync tues 11am for go/no-go. prompts to author: 1) summarize transcript (3 lines) 2) tone rewrite few-shot (3 lines) 3) product idea brainstorm (3 lines).
mar: thanks team :rocket:
